source.title: Terrain Tiles on AWS (Mapzen terrarium elevation tiles)
source.note: Mean ground height per 0.0625 degree cell from the terrarium tiles at zoom 6 (https://s3.amazonaws.com/elevation-tiles-prod/terrarium/{z}/{x}/{y}.png). In the United States the tiles are built from USGS 3DEP (formerly NED), SRTM and GMTED2010 (courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey) and NOAA ETOPO1, all public domain; ArcticDEM data were created from DigitalGlobe, Inc., imagery and funded under National Science Foundation awards 1043681, 1559691 and 1542736. Used only to shape the snowfall heat map between stations; no height is displayed.

license: public domain (US sources), attribution in the note
encoding: 16 bit greyscale PNG, value = metres + 0; rows from the north edge, columns from the west edge, cell centers at half steps
